name: Random Birth Cohorts — 100K Baseline
description: 100,000 randomly generated birth records for null hypothesis testing, base rate establishment, and Monte Carlo studies. Seeded RNG (seed=42) for full reproducibility. Geographic distribution approximates global population (Asia 60%, Africa 17%, Europe 10%, North America 8%, South America 4.5%, Oceania 0.5%). Birth years uniform 1900-2020. Birth times uniform across 24h. No computed astrological data — raw birth parameters only.
source_description: Seeded pseudorandom algorithm (seed=42). Geographic distribution weighted to global population. Temporal distribution uniform 1900-2020.
known_limitations: Geographic distribution is approximate — uses region-weighted country sampling, not population-density-weighted
Timezone inferred from longitude only — no DST or historical timezone transitions
No computed astrological data — must be processed through computation pipeline for RS-FLAT
Birth years capped at 2020 to avoid speculative future data
known_biases: Geographic distribution uses simplified region/country model — does not match exact UN population statistics
Coastal over-representation due to uniform lat/lng sampling within regions
confidence_notes: All records are synthetic — no real individuals
intended_use: Null hypothesis testing, base rate establishment, distribution analysis, Monte Carlo studies
prohibited_uses: Must not be represented as real birth data
